about: Culture pack C6 (owner, Oct 21): the guide's four New York date spots. Any place with a meal is a date spot (lib/dating.ts canDateAt); these four get Lola's line on their card, above "Make it a date". The date night costs the place's first meal, as always.

spots.line: Flushing food court: twenty stalls, one table, split everything. If they share the last soup dumpling, babe, that's love.
A picnic on the lawn, the bridge lit up, bodega sandwiches on a blanket. Cheap, cute and nobody can hear you nervous-laugh.
The rooftop: heat lamps, the whole skyline and Kiki on the list. Dress like you're on the list, too.
The 2 AM deli date: two chopped cheeses, the cat watching, Sal pretending not to. If it works here, it works anywhere. Deadass.
